name: DataComp for Language Models (DCLM)
description: DCLM is a testbed for controlled dataset experiments aimed at improving language models. It provides a standardized corpus of 240T tokens, pretraining recipes, and a suite of 53 downstream evaluations to study data curation strategies at various model scales.
reputation: A recent and influential testbed for studying data curation in language model pretraining, but still emerging rather than a long-established community benchmark.
notes: Focuses on dataset design and curation strategies for training language models; includes large-scale data and multiple evaluation tasks.
